DLC2324:3:t_1:5.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「How is it, Doctor? Did you collect the $$真化融合$$ data?」

DLC2324:3:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's astonishing. The theory was complete, but seeing it with my own eyes... Unbelievable is the only word for it.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The fusion of human and machine wills... Even if I understand it intellectually, crossing the boundary between organic and inorganic is still astounding.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's a miracle born of fighting beside our beloved machines all this time... and of the $$次元力$$ gathered from Earth. What else could you call it?」

DLC2324:3:t_1:9.en:
$$トビー$$
「Now we've got nothing to fear, even if those damn $$御使い$$s send in black $$アンゲロイ$$ or $$クリスタル超獣$$s.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:10.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Don't get too optimistic. All we've done is finally gain the strength to fight them on equal terms.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:11.en:
$$トライア$$
「Captain $$デンゼル$$'s right. The $$御使い$$s' power is probably still far beyond ours.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「If $$真化融合$$ is what finally lets us put up a proper fight, we need training to master it.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is our precious trump card. Allow me to prepare a special training ground where you can learn to use it.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:16.en:
$$エスター$$
「Whenever you start acting helpful, I can't help thinking there's a catch...」

DLC2324:3:t_1:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, don't say that. Dr. $$トライア$$... Please load this data into the simulator.」

DLC2324:3:t_1:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The culmination of my $$スフィア$$ research. Please put it to good use.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Even stronger enemies are waiting for us...」

DLC2324:3:t_2:5.en:
$n
「Right now, all we can do is trust in ourselves and our machines and keep going.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Every last one of the guys we're gonna meet is a real piece of work.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「But we'll do it anyway. We've come this far.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... For the people waiting on Earth, too.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（$$ヴィルダーク$$, $$アサキム$$, and $c each hold four of the twelve $$スフィア$$s.）

DLC2324:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（And $$ヴィルダーク$$, $$アサキム$$, and the $$御使い$$s are each trying to gather the $$スフィア$$s.）

DLC2324:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（If one defeats another and the $$スフィア$$s are brought together in one place, $c may not be able to win...）

DLC2324:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Now that they have achieved $$真化融合$$, they are evenly matched with the enemy... In that case, where the $$スフィア$$s end up will decide the outcome of this battle...）

DLC2324:3:t_2:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（I am counting on you all... I cannot stand the thought of anyone but me doing as they please with the universe.）

DLC2324:3:t_2:16.en:
$n
「You've lost everyone's trust. If you show the slightest sign of doing anything suspicious...」

DLC2324:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haha... Having come this far, I am committed as well. Your fate and mine are bound together.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:19.en:
$n
「For now... I'll take your word for that, $$ＡＧ$$.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:20.en:
$n
「Unless we all bring our strength together, I don't think we'll make it through the battles ahead.」

DLC2324:3:t_2:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
（And the one who holds the final key, $n... will surely be you.）

DLC2324:4:t_000:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well, I'll be. You've already recreated $$カオス・コスモス$$ from data.」

DLC2324:4:t_000:1.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ and the Chief are really proud of this simulation. Is everyone ready?」

DLC2324:4:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since this is training, most of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s event control will be disabled...」

DLC2324:4:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have also prepared ten A-Adapters, so please make use of them when preparing to deploy.」

DLC2324:4:t_001:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So, who's our opponent? Are you gonna throw some black $$アンゲロイ$$ at us?」

DLC2324:4:t_002:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s $$リアクター$$s!」

DLC2324:4:t_002:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「They even brought their adjutants and attendants!」

DLC2324:4:t_002:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And the ones in the back are $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム$$, huh?」

DLC2324:4:t_002:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you think, everyone? Quite something, isn't it?」

DLC2324:4:t_002:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even if it's a simulation, fighting this many enemies...」

DLC2324:4:t_003:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With this power, you should be able to face any enemy.」

DLC2324:4:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Fight with $$真化融合$$.」
「Fight without using $$真化融合$$.」

DLC2324:4:t_005:0.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$! You and the Doctor went to all the trouble of preparing this data! We'll make full use of it!」

DLC2324:4:t_005:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. Then let us give this our all!」

DLC2324:4:t_005:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Final Ultimate Gorgeous Victory Final Battle begins!!」

DLC2324:4:t_006:0.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$... Can you seal off the power of $$真化融合$$?」

DLC2324:4:t_006:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Within the simulation, yes. But why in the world would you want to do that?」

DLC2324:4:t_006:2.en:
$n
「The $$御使い$$s are stronger than those enemies. Only by winning without $$真化融合$$ can we truly fight the $$御使い$$s on equal terms.」

DLC2324:4:t_006:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We've beaten them once. We should at least be able to pull this off.」

DLC2324:4:t_006:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I've made up my mind too.」

DLC2324:4:t_006:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood! If you wish to attempt this challenge, I, $$ＡＧ$$, shall assist you!」

DLC2324:4:t_007:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, everyone! Do your best at this challenge, reckless though it may be!」

DLC2324:4:t_007:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Final Ultimate Gorgeous Victory Final Battle begins!!」

DLC2324:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「If we couldn't beat these guys, we'd never stand a chance against the $$御使い$$s.」

DLC2324:4:t_004:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At least now I've got the confidence to keep fighting.」

DLC2324:4:t_004:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All that's left is to move forward.」

DLC2324:4:t_004:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, everyone. You have certainly justified my decision to reveal everything and pledge my support.」

DLC2324:4:t_004:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But do not forget that even stronger enemies await you.」

DLC2324:4:t_004:7.en:
$n
「Neither we nor Earth can turn back now.」

DLC2324:4:t_100:0.en:
$$ランド$$
（Looking back on it now, fighting you... wasn't so bad.）

DLC2324:4:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
（It's a shame, $$エルーナルーナ$$. If we'd met under different circumstances, we might've been good friends...）

DLC2324:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ランド$$
（Come to think of it, $$ダバラーン$$... is still alive...）

DLC2324:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ランド$$
（I'm asking you, don't go trying to avenge $$エルーナルーナ$$. Our fight with you is over.）

review.context: The team studies Shinka Fusion and trains against a simulation of Sidereal Reactors, Advent and Asakim. The protagonist can choose whether to use Shinka Fusion.
decisions: Heralds uses the canonical term with plural suffixes on the glossary token.
The two-choice row retains two independently quoted choices in one record.
AG selfish motive about controlling the universe is retained explicitly.
Preserved the interrupted threat across two consecutive protagonist rows.
Meaning-preserving fit revision at DLC2324:3:t_1:8: numerical coordinates or compact miracle wording; all source details retained.
